answer.rationale: Memory 57 is strongest because it explicitly reports qualified revenue with no measurable retention harm. Memory 44 directly addresses higher-quality enterprise pipeline, though it omits realized revenue and retention. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift but does not establish margin, retention, or durability under promotional pricing. Memories 31 and 86 show activation/adoption improvements that may be leading indicators but omit qualified revenue and long-term retention outcomes. Memory 91 is limited to week-one engagement and first meaningful action, with no direct revenue, qualification, or durability evidence.
